evidence.model_evidence: The supplied live_retrieval_evidence contains 100+ search results from Bing for site-specific queries (arbeitsagentur.de, stepstone.de, adzuna.de, arbeitnow.com, germantechjobs.de, eurotechjobs.com, remotive.com, hitmarker.net). Every result is irrelevant: Wikipedia pages, YouTube help articles, AOL login pages, DFB (German football) sites, Sky community forums, Morlock Motors news, and adult content. None expose a real job listing/API or direct vacancy cards for QA/testing roles in Berlin, Leipzig, Dresden, or Germany-wide remote. The registry already holds 10 active sources verified in prior cycles, but the current live retrieval evidence alone does not verify any source.
